entities.summary: Miguel de Barrios was a poet, playwright, and historian, born in Montilla, Spain, to a Portuguese converso family. He eventually settled in Amsterdam in the Portuguese Jewish community. He was a prolific author, whose best known works are a memorialization of victims of the Inquisition, Contra la verdad no hay fuerza, and a laudatory portrayal of Amsterdam's Sephardic community, Triumpho del govierno popular (1683). He was one of several writers to focus on "the [Jewish] Law's perfection, eternity and superiority.
